pool.text: Diego de Montemayor founded Ciudad Metropolitana de Nuestra Señora de Monterrey.
Monterrey was selected as the capital of the State of Nuevo León.
Garcia Caves were discovered in Garcia, Nuevo León.
The Battle of Monterrey took place as an early large-scale engagement.
The brewery Cervecería Cuauhtémoc was founded as a milestone enterprise.
A steel-producing company accelerated the fast industrialization of the city.
Mexico's first steel mills opened in Monterrey.
Monterrey hosted several games of the FIFA World Cup.
Hurricane Gilbert caused great damage and flooding in the city.
Fortune magazine rated Monterrey as the best city in Latin America.
The city hosted the United Nations Conference on Financing for Development.
The OAS Special Summit of the Americas was attended by presidents.
The song Los Oxidados by Plastilina Mosh opened a movie.
Parque Nacional Cumbres de Monterrey received a biosphere reserve designation.
An Inuit artist created a sculpture gifted by Canada.
Hurricane Alex brought record-breaking rain and floods to Monterrey.
A terror attack occurred on a casino in the city.
Monterrey achieved a specific GDP and per capita metric.
The area faced a severe drought with water service limitations.
Tesla announced plans to build Gigafactory Mexico near Monterrey.
